text: Online pharmacy orders are filled and shipped by the mail order team. Here's what the team and its manager see.
The one thing to remember: the team fills and ships orders. The manager also settles auto-ship prices, refunds and abandoned carts. Neither has reports, catalog or settings.
This is Jesse, on the mail order team. No Catalog and no Settings.
Their main screen is in Pharmacy:
the Mail Order Queue. Fill, ship and notify.
Orders move through these steps. Approval decisions live on the assigned task.
New mail order starts one by hand.
There's no Analytics link: mail order has no reports.
Now Alex, the mail order manager. Pharmacy adds a Store tab.
On an order, the manager can also mark it paid, change an auto-ship's price or quantity, and resend abandoned carts.
The most common mistake is giving mail order staff a client liaison role just to look up a client. They can already open client records.
Remember: the team fills and ships orders; the manager also settles prices, refunds and abandoned carts.
